📘 **Lesson 1**

Hello everyone! Welcome to our first introduction to Java programming in this beginner'self-paced course. Today, we will learn about Java itself—a powerful object-oriented language used for building robust applications and also set up your development environment so you can start coding right away. Here’s what today’s lesson covers:

**Objective: Understand what Java is and set up the dev environment (30 min)**  
1. **What Is Java? (5 mins):** We'll begin with a brief history of how Java came to be, its purpose in industry, security features like JIT compilation & garbage collection, and why it’s popular among developers worldwide. 
2. **Setting Up the Environment: Eclipse IDE for Android Development (10 mins):** I will guide you step-by-step on installing necessary software—Eclipse ADT Bundle to write Java code along with its plugins required specifically for building apps using Android SDK, and how configure your environment accordingly so that it becomes an efficient coding space.
3. **Writing Your First "Hello World!" Program (15 mins):** We'll create a simple program in Eclipse—a basic HelloWorld app which prints the text “Hello world!” on the screen using Java syntax, demonstrating data types and control flow concepts along with how to compile & run our code.
4. **Q&A Session: Understanding Any Doubts (5 mins):** I encourage you all in this session of questions for clarifying your doubts about what we have learned so far! Let’s ensure everyone is on the same page before moving forward to learn more complex concepts and Java fundamentals.

That's it, folks – our introductory lesson concludes here with a new understanding of why you might want to start learning this versatile language & how we can get started by setting up your development environment in Eclipse IDE for Android Development today! Happy coding ahead everyone! Let’s learn together and grow as developers.

---
Say **'complete'** to mark this lesson done and continue.
Say **'exit course'** to leave the course.
Say **'progress'** to see your course progress.
